A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before we
get growing.

Where do you work?+

We serve New Bedford and surrounding areas. Add your address to the quote request so we can confirm service at your property.

Can I book regular lawn care?+

Yes—ask about weekly or biweekly lawn maintenance. Share your yard details and preferred frequency so we can discuss scheduling.

How do I get a price?+

Complete the quote request with your property details, services, and any photos you can share. Aaron or Alvin can then discuss the work and pricing with you.

Can I request a one-time cleanup?+

Absolutely. Select a one-time service and tell us what needs attention, including leaves, overgrowth, hedges, or your planting beds.
